_comment: Reactive sub-agent completion demo (NOT seeded — import via Flow Builder). The flow starts when a child run of the matched agent reaches the 'completed' terminal state (on_subagent_complete), summarises the result with an LLM and outputs it. Nodes spaced 360px on x, y=0. Validates R1-R11.

config.system_prompt: Summarise the finished sub-agent result for the parent in two sentences.
